subject: Post-demo recap & trial checklist for Razor Labs
messages:
From: Sophia Chen <sophia@razorlabs.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Morales <alex.morales@razorlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + success criteria after today's demo

Aisha — thanks for the demo today. Alex and I dug it, especially the throughput on 1k prompt bursts. A few quick notes and what we need to see during the 4-week trial to feel confident about moving to a pilot deployment: 

- Success criteria (must-haves):
  • avg generation latency < 220ms on our median 512-token prompts under 50rps sustained
  • no data egress (all logs stay in our VPC) and KMS-based key control for embeddings
  • model outputs to pass our safety filters (FP rate < 1% on our test prompts)

- Operational needs:
  • integration guide for your streaming API (examples for Python + Node)
  • simple cost estimator for our projected 50M tokens/mo

- Timing & owner asks:
  • trial window: Sep 20 — Oct 17 (4 weeks)
  • can you confirm an endpoint in us-west-2?
  • can we get a shared spreadsheet of acceptance tests and who owns them?

Also, we saw that one of the demo responses returned a hallucinated company name in the example — minor but want to track it as quality risk. Please put a mitigation plan in the trial playbook.

Thanks —
Sophia
Senior PM, Razor Labs

Attachments: evaluation-criteria-template.xlsx (we attached our internal acceptance checklist)

Summary & next steps (actionable):
1) Trial infra: we can provision a dedicated trial endpoint in us-west-2 and restrict logs to your VPC via our Private deployment connector. Owner: Ben Carter. ETA for endpoint: Sep 19 (will provide hostname + TLS cert).

2) Acceptance spreadsheet: I created a shared sheet with the criteria you listed and added a few Redwood-specific checks (KV cache hit rates, token cost per 1k) — link included below. Owner: Marissa Cole (she'll coordinate test owners).

3) Security & key control: we support KMS integration and will provide a short integration doc + SOC2 artifacts. Owner: Ben — will attach a SOC2 extract and our security FAQ.

4) Safety/quality mitigation: we'll add a guardrail config and an evaluation harness that runs your test prompts each night during the trial. If FP rate > 1% we'll run a canned rollback to the safer model variant and open a bug. Owner: Aisha (me) for rollout policy; Ben for rollback ops.

5) Cost estimator: Marissa will share a cost projection based on your 50M tokens/month and several batching scenarios by Sep 17.

6) Open quality issue (hallucinated company name): noted — Ben, please capture a test case and add to the hotlist.

Attachments I'm adding now: redwood-trial-playbook.docx (draft), razor-multiparty-map.xlsx (shared acceptance sheet), trace-sample.txt (sample trace format we'll collect).

Can you confirm the trial window still works for you? I will send a calendar invite for the kickoff on Sep 20 once Ben confirms endpoint readiness.

Thanks,
Aisha
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

- Endpoint: provisioning started. Estimated ready-by: 2027-09-19T16:00:00-07:00. I will post the hostname and cert thumbprint to the HubSpot deal record and the shared drive.

- Logs / VPC connector: we have the connector steps in the playbook; will need a service account from Razor with least-priv S3 write + KMS decrypt to validate retention. Action: Marissa, can you add the exact IAM policy snippet to the playbook and cc Razor?

- Hotlist: created a Jira ticket RAZ-ENG-12 for the hallucination test case and attached repro steps + sample trace (trace-sample.txt). Severity: medium for now; if nightly eval shows FP > 1% we'll escalate to SE + model team.

I'll be on standby during the kickoff and can run a short smoke test (3x 512-token requests at 50rps) to validate the latency SLO.

Ben
